title: Five tips to learn a language faster – level 1
paragraphs: Do you want to learn a new language? Here are five easy and fun ways to do it.

First, do not learn hard rules. Learn 50 simple words and phrases which you need every day. Second, listen to the language a lot. You can use YouTube, the radio, or audiobooks. Third, talk to yourself, your dog, or a green plant in your room. This helps you speak without fear. Fourth, sit on your sofa and watch TV, films, or children’s shows. You can also look at social media to see real-life words. Fifth, talk to an AI chatbot. It is like a teacher who is with you all day and night. You can make mistakes, and the chatbot will help you.
In the end, remember the most important thing: you must go out and talk to people!
